entities.title: The CI/CD container's Cloudflare token may lack D1, R2 and Queues
entities.summary: The database cyberspace, the bucket cyberspace and the queues cyberspace-scans and cyberspace-scans-failed exist (created 2026-11-24) and both configurations carry the database id, so a deploy by hand works. The container deploys both Workers with its own token, which also needs D1, R2 and Queues permissions.
entities.cause: The container's token was made for the explorer's Worker alone; nobody has checked whether it was given D1, R2 and Queues permissions.
entities.unblockWhen: The container's secret cloudflare_api_token has Account → D1: Edit, Workers R2 Storage: Edit and Queues: Edit (crawler/README.md, "Setting it up once (the owner)", step 3).

blocked.description: The container's deploy of the crawler fails without these permissions; a deploy by hand does not.
